correctness.rationale: Grouping nonempty subsets by exact gcd g gives f(floor(n/g)) in each class. Hence the deficit Δ_D is one plus the sum over nondivisor indices. Its first term g=r has size 2^floor(n/r) up to the gcd>1 union-bound error; the remaining at most n terms are at most 2^floor(n/(r+1)) each. Every binomial coefficient in row m divides lcm(1,…,m), since each floor difference in its p-adic valuation is 0 or 1 and vanishes beyond log_p m. This gives n≥2^(r−1)/r, so r=O(log n). The gap between the leading floor and the next is at least n/[r(r+1)]−1; after division by the main term both errors, including their polynomial factors, are O(exp(−cn/log²n)). The first index for Δ_Φ is the least prime factor, so direct lower and upper bounds give the exponent comparison, with gap at least 1/6 in the appropriate direction by parity. A least nondivisor cannot have two coprime proper prime-power factors. Its exact p-adic characterization and the identity r>R iff lcm(1,…,R)|n give the density and summable tail; the bounded-test-function truncation proves weak convergence without mass at zero.
residual_risks: Replay independently uses Möbius inversion through n=450 and explicit subset gcds through 17, tests lcm divisibility through 160 and fibers through 180000. It corroborates but does not establish the infinite estimates and law. The uniform constant is existential.
